# Test fixture PDFs

Small PDFs used by `tests/test_extract_pdf.py`, generated by hand (stdlib only):

- `text.pdf`: 3 pages, one sentence each
- `image_only.pdf`: 1 page that only draws a filled rectangle (no text)
- `too_many_pages.pdf`: 201 empty pages
- `corrupt.pdf`: a PDF header followed by garbage

Regenerate with `cd api && uv run python tests/fixtures/make_fixtures.py`.
The script is a development aid only, not a runtime dependency.
